from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
a=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png')).astype(int)
r,g,b=a[:,:,0],a[:,:,1],a[:,:,2]
blue=(b>90)&(b>r+30)&(b>g+10)
# column counts to gauge blur
cols=blue.sum(0); rows=blue.sum(1)
print('col counts (x:count):')
print({x:int(cols[x]) for x in range(116,146) if cols[x]})
print('row counts:')
print({y:int(rows[y]) for y in range(60,92) if rows[y]})
# sample strong blue core colors
core=blue&(b>150)
ys,xs=np.where(core)
print('core count',core.sum())
sel=a[core]
print('core mean RGB', sel.mean(0), 'min', sel.min(0), 'max', sel.max(0))
# white seam pixels
white=(r>150)&(g>150)&(b>150)&(np.abs(r-g)<25)&(np.abs(g-b)<25)
ys2,xs2=np.where(white)
if len(xs2): print('white bbox', xs2.min(),xs2.max(),ys2.min(),ys2.max(), 'mean', a[white].mean(0))
# wood sample colors near ball rows, away from ball
wood = a[70:85, 90:115].reshape(-1,3)
print('wood mean', wood.mean(0), 'std', wood.std(0))
glass = a[75:95, 215:245].reshape(-1,3)
print('glass area mean', glass.mean(0), 'std', glass.std(0))
\"
